svg.title: Neon Grid City: an event-driven serverless pipeline drawn as an isometric city
svg.desc: Isometric neon city. Each building is a service: EventBridge, Lambda, DynamoDB Streams, Step Functions and Glue/Spark. Light packets travel the streets between them. Part of a platform of 50+ AWS microservices he helped build and support.
svg.text: I helped build and support. Every building
is a service; every light is an event.
